## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests (parser / checker / golden, see docs/TESTING.md)
- [ ] Generated example files are regenerated if the generator output changed
- [ ] `docs/SUPPORTED_CQL.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for user-visible changes
